notes.title: Release Hotfix: Smooth(ie) screen
notes.content:
[h1]First hotfix[/h1]

Hello fellow Oneironauts! After a release week that was over any expectations we had, we wanted to thank all of you that has interacted with our game in any way. All your feedback, and support makes us feel like we are currently in a dream. 

With this Release hotfix, we've fixed the following: 

[h2]Screen tearing[/h2]
We noticed that people had a lot of problems with screen tearing, so we implemented optimizations to make sure that wont happen again. Now you can happily play the game on that VHS TV without a problem! 

[*] V-sync and Framerate updating "properly" now.

[h2]Optimization[/h2]
Lower end PCs seemed to struggle a lot with keeping up with The Oneironauts speed. Which some might have felt was a blessing, but mostly just annoying. 

[*] Optimized the game to work better on lower end PCs, and at the same speed as everyone else. 

[h2]Steam deck support[/h2]
We noticed a large amount of Steam deck users loved our game, and we want them to have the same opportunity as everyone else. We are hard at work to make it completely supported for Steam Deck. 
It is already playable on a Steam deck, and with this hotfix, it will (hopefully) run as smooth as butter.

[*]  Started work on Optimization and Support for Steam Deck

Again, a GIANT thank you to all of you. You make our dream, a reality. 

// Jetebra Games

notes.title: The Oneironaut 40% off until april 14th
notes.content:
[h2]THANK YOU ALL[/h2]
We want to once again thank everyone that has been part of the journey, and played The Oneironaut. The feedback from all of you has been so wonderful, and positive. We couldn't imagine just how much people would like the game and the world that surrounds it. So from the bottom of our hearts here at Jetebra Games. Thank you. 

[h2]HOTFIX IS INCOMING[/h2]
But this is just the beginning! We are currently working on the first major hotfix, which will hopefully fix a lot of the bugs and wanted features people have reached out about. If you have any more feedback for us, please join our Discord and message with us developer directly there! 

[h2]GET IT NOW WHILE ITS HOT[/h2]
We just want to remind the ones who might not have come around to buy the game yet, that the release sale is still ongoing, up until the 14th of April.

notes.title: The Oneironaut is Out Now!
notes.content:
[h1] The Oneironaut is Out Now! [/h1] 

Our journey to develop and release The Oneironaut started 1.5+ years ago, 
today we hit the Launch button!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45063691/5dd6373c8a17ab7e0bc6c0da12c5da302b72fbbd.png[/img] 

This journey started as an experiment. An attempt to bring art and ambient music into a dreamlike digital space. 

Along the way, it transformed into something much bigger: 
a new take on the Runner genre, blending an relaxing and ambient experience with parkour action.
Seeing this vision come to life with your support has been incredible!

[h3] To everyone in our community and our playtesters: [/h3] 
Thank you. Your support, feedback, and excitement have kept us going 
through every step of development. This game wouldn’t be the same without you.

[h3]We want to hear from you! [/h3] 
Your feedback helps shape the future of The Oneironaut.
Drop your thoughts over at our Discord to chat with us directly: 
https://discord.gg/wGF6UQt3gU 
We'll also be closely monitoring in-game bug reports.

Thank you
From all of us here at Jetebra Games
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45063691/ed4aae3d6a986521a1406f3eeb10584da42a825f.png[/img]
